svg.title: Conservation ranger — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as conservation ranger, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Two distinct field-binocular lenses and short barrels sit above a separate veined conservation leaf. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
